meta.name: team-topologies
meta.description: Organize business and technology teams for fast flow using Skelton & Pais's "Team Topologies". Use when the user mentions "team topologies", "Conway's law", "platform team", "stream-aligned team", "team boundaries", "cognitive load", "how should we split teams", "who owns this service", "team dependencies", or "reorg". Also trigger when reorganizing engineering teams, aligning team and service boundaries, splitting a monolith and deciding ownership, reducing cross-team handoffs, or designing an internal platform. Covers the four team types, three interaction modes, the inverse Conway maneuver, and fracture planes. For bounded contexts, see domain-driven-design. For dependency direction in code, see clean-architecture.

copy.tagline: 根据康威定律和团队拓扑学组织团队结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在重新组织工程团队或拆分单体服务。
copy.tagline_en: Organize teams for fast flow using Team Topologies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are reorganizing engineering teams or splitting a monolith.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据团队拓扑学原则，帮你分析并设计团队结构，包括四种团队类型、三种交互模式、反向康威定律和断裂面，并给出评分和改进建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“团队拓扑”、“康威定律”、“平台团队”、“流对齐团队”、“团队边界”、“认知负荷”、“如何拆分团队”、“谁拥有这个服务”、“团队依赖”或“重组”等关键词，或要求重组工程团队、对齐团队与服务边界、拆分单体并决定所有权、减少跨团队交接、设计内部平台时触发。

say.text: 我们团队现在有前端、后端、DBA三个组件团队，怎么改成流对齐团队？
say.note: Claude 会分析当前结构并给出转型步骤。

say.text: 帮我用团队拓扑原则评估一下我们工程组织的得分。
say.note: Claude 会按0-10分评分并列出改进项。

say.text: 我们想设计一个内部平台，应该从什么开始？
say.note: Claude 会介绍最薄可行平台的概念和起步方法。
